summary: Iteration 4 backend testing for Jawad Net ERP v1.4. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py with 10 new tests covering: (a) BUG FIX for /api/public/card-order/login rate-limit on non-existent phones, (b) POST /api/sales mandatory customer_id + sale_type validations, (c) PUT /api/purchases/{id} edit endpoint with supplier balance auto-adjust + cancel & permission gates. Verified the reported bug (non-existent phones did not count toward rate limit) reproduced on original code, then FIXED in server.py public_login and confirmed 6th attempt now returns 429. Result: 10/10 new tests pass; full regression suite 67/67 pass sequentially.

minor.issue: _adjust_party_balance is called BEFORE purchases.update_one — if update_one later fails, supplier balance/ledger would be out of sync (same non-atomic pattern as sales edit). Consider transactional wrap or rollback.
No validation that new_paid >= 0 or new_paid <= new_total. A negative paid or paid greater than total is accepted, producing weird remaining values.
Non-existent-phone attempts now count, but the 404 still leaks whether a phone exists (attacker can differentiate 404 vs 401). Consider returning same status for both to prevent phone enumeration.
Not implemented (returns 404). Test worked around by direct DB status update. If cancel purchase is expected functionality, endpoint needs to be added.

No re-check that user is editing an existing supplier's purchase; supplier balance adjust is skipped for purchases with supplier_id=None (walk-in), which is fine, but audit does not record old_paid/old_discount — only old_total.

action_items: None critical — fixed the public login non-existent-phone rate-limit bug in server.py public_login (added counter increment + 5-fail block for phones not in customers collection).
Consider wrapping edit_purchase in a transaction: _adjust_party_balance runs before purchases.update_one; failure between the two leaves supplier ledger inconsistent.
Consider adding POST /api/purchases/{id}/cancel endpoint (currently missing; only sales have cancel).
Consider unifying 404/401 responses on public login to prevent phone enumeration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1587 lines — split recommendation from iter 2/3 still open.
public_login fix: added 5-fail counter for non-existent phones, uses same public_blocks doc and identical 429 detail message.
PUT /purchases/{id} audit only stores {old_total, new_total}; missing old_paid/new_paid/old_discount which would be needed for reconciliation.
SaleIn.sale_type is a plain str with no enum validation at pydantic level — validation happens in the handler. Consider Literal['cash','credit'] for automatic 422 error.
seed_data_creation: Each test uses unique uuid-based phones/names; seeds category/stock/purchase/sale per test. No cleanup done aside from public_blocks entries used in login tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration4.py connects directly to Mongo to clean/inspect public_blocks entries for non-existent phone tests. The bug reported in the request (5 wrong attempts on non-existent phone should register but curl showed only 404 on 6th) was reproduced and FIXED in /app/backend/server.py public_login: now increments failed counter and blocks at 5 for phones not in customers collection. All iteration 4 endpoints work as spec'd.
rca of the issue: RCA of the public-login rate-limit bug: The original public_login handler raised HTTPException(404) immediately when customers.find_one returned None, BEFORE any public_blocks increment logic. So attempts against non-existent phones never populated public_blocks.failed, and the 6th attempt continued to return 404 rather than 429. Fix: inside the `if not customer:` branch, before raising 404, upsert public_blocks with incremented `failed` counter and, at failed>=5, set blocked_until=+24h (same shape as wrong-password path), and also emit a notification. Verified by test_five_wrong_attempts_on_nonexistent_phone_returns_429_on_sixth (5 x 404 then 429 with detail 'تم حظر الإدخال...'). Regression test for valid phone (test_valid_phone_still_returns_401_and_increments) confirms wrong-password path still works and successful login still resets counter.
